title: 5 tons of human waste below Angels Landing #Shorts
description:
In 2021 park crews hauled almost five tons of human waste off the toilets at Scout Lookout, just below the Angels Landing chains. That's what five million visitors look like.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #Zion #AngelsLanding #NationalParks
